title: Verify: Draw helpers and room size registry unit tests
summary: Unit tests for draw.ts and roomSizes.ts
description: Write tests from the R1 acceptance criteria with no I/O.
acceptance_criteria: createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, dither and rampIndex behave as specified
ROOM_ART_SIZES lists 13 positive integer sizes and the shell heights sum to 270
technical_constraints: Unit tests only, nothing mocked is needed beyond pure imports
Shared palette of at most 48 colours is read from src/lib/palette.ts, never copied

steps.action: Create the file. Test rampIndex('wood',2) equals PALETTE.indexOf(PALETTE_RAMPS.wood[2]); rampIndex('indigo',6) throws; createGrid(4,3,7) equals three rows of [7,7,7,7]; fillRect(createGrid(3,3,0),1,1,5,5,9) clips so only cells (1,1),(2,1),(1,2),(2,2) are 9; outlineRect(createGrid(4,4,0),0,0,4,4,5) leaves the 2x2 centre 0; shadeRect over 1x4 with ramp 'wood', 4 and 1 gives indices wood 4,3,2,1 descending; dither(createGrid(2,2,0),0,0,2,2,1,2) gives [[1,2],[2,1]].
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/roomDraw.test.ts
